name: FEE-HELP
summary: A government loan for tuition if you're in a full-fee place rather than a Commonwealth supported place.
who: Australian citizens completing at least one unit in Australia.
Eligible non-citizens resident in Australia for the unit.
need: A tax file number, or proof you've applied for one.
The FEE-HELP eCAF from your provider.
how: Accept your course offer. Your provider then gives you the eCAF.
Submit the eCAF on or before the census date.
catches: A 20% loan fee applies to some undergraduate study.
Getting FEE-HELP doesn't mean your fees are capped. Check the cost against your HELP limit.
The census date is also the last day to drop a unit without paying for it.
